_meta.sources.url: The package index URL used as a dependency source. It specifies where Pipenv should search for and download packages, such as the official PyPI index or a private package repository.
default: The locked production dependency section. It contains the resolved runtime dependencies corresponding to the [packages] section in the Pipfile, including exact versions, hashes, markers, and source information.
docs: The locked production dependency section. It contains the resolved runtime dependencies corresponding to the [packages] section in the Pipfile, including exact versions, hashes, markers, and source information.
tests: A custom dependency category for testing-related packages. It may contain dependencies used for running tests, measuring coverage, or supporting test infrastructure, such as pytest, pytest-cov, or test helper libraries.
